Plot the edges of a network comparison

Source: R/network-plots.R
plot_network_comparison.Rd

Plots, for the selected edge set, how much each edge's partial correlation varies across the compared cell types (max_diff), with the per-cell-type edge counts and pairwise Jaccard overlap in the subtitle. Up to 50 edges are shown.

Usage

plot_network_comparison(
  comparison,
  highlight = c("differential", "shared", "all")
)

Arguments

comparison

NetworkComparison.

highlight

Character; which edges to plot: "differential" (default), "shared", or "all".

Value

A ggplot object.

Examples

shared_edge <- S4Vectors::DataFrame(
    node_i = "G1", node_j = "M1", category = "shared",
    max_diff = 0.1
)
differential_edge <- S4Vectors::DataFrame(
    node_i = "G2", node_j = "M1", category = "differential",
    max_diff = 0.5
)
comparison <- NetworkComparison(
    diff_edges = differential_edge,
    shared_edges = shared_edge,
    celltype_specific = list(),
    summary = list(
        celltypes = c("Monocyte", "B cell"),
        n_edges = c(Monocyte = 2L, `B cell` = 1L),
        n_shared = 1L,
        n_differential = 1L,
        jaccard = list(Monocyte_vs_B_cell = 0.5)
    )
)
if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
    comparison_plot <- plot_network_comparison(
        comparison,
        highlight = "differential"
    )
    inherits(comparison_plot, "ggplot")
}
#> [1] TRUE
